title: Which should come next?
body: Current is still growing. Pick what you would use first: one, or several.
thanks: Thank you. Your answer reached the studio.

title: Current is part of Pullula
body: Pullula is the studio's family of instruments and playables. Current, Fracture and the tools to come live together on one shelf.

title: Call for artists: a show of moving fields
body: The studio is gathering work made with flow fields, particles, plotters and sound for a show in Miami. Send a link to one piece; we write back to everyone.

form.consent: The studio may email me about this show and keep these details until it is over.

thanks: Thank you. We will write back.
